items.title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
items.summary: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.

items.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
items.summary: Every major token gained on Friday as traders cut bets on a September Federal Reserve rate increase to a coin flip, though most of the majors are barely changed on the week.

items.title: Uniswap Labs Bought Pons Token for 'Long-Term Alignment'
items.summary: Pons said Uniswap Labs purchased its token "for long-term alignment" four weeks after Uniswap Labs put a rival launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

items.title: Utah Becomes First State to Target VPNs in Age-Verification Crackdown
items.summary: Privacy advocates say the law raises First Amendment questions the courts have yet to address.
